Questions

Before you buy.

Is this safe? Will it get me banned?

Pandora only changes Windows settings and documented config files. It never touches game memory or anti-cheat, and every change is reversible. That said, every game and platform sets its own rules, so we can’t guarantee how any of them treats system changes. Check the rules of the games you play.

What do I actually receive?

An instant download link by email with the guide PDFs, tool installers and setup checklist. Lifetime updates are free.

Do I need to restart afterwards?

Yes. Restart your PC after applying tweaks so every change takes effect.

Why does Windows or my antivirus show a warning?

Pandora changes system settings, so it may need administrator permission and Windows SmartScreen or your antivirus can flag it. Only download from the link in your purchase email or our official Discord, and open a ticket if you’re unsure about a warning.

Will it work on my PC?

Pandora Utility is built for Windows PCs. Pandora scans your hardware on launch and recommends tweaks for your parts. Not sure about your setup? Ask in our Discord before you buy.

Can I get a refund?

Because products are delivered digitally, all sales are final. Your legal consumer rights are not affected. Read the full Terms in our Discord.

Where do I get support?

Open a ticket in our Discord. Please don’t DM staff directly, tickets are the fastest way to get help.

Can I buy more than one product at once?

No. Orders are limited to one item at a time, so check out with one product, then place another order if you need it.

Do I get updates?

Yes. Lifetime updates are free for the product you bought.

Can I share my copy with a friend?

No. Your licence is for personal use and can’t be shared, resold or leaked. Doing so ends your access without a refund.
